---
title: "Errors"
description: "Error reporting and capture recovery."
---

`createCapture()` rejects if initialization fails. After initialization, capture failures appear in `onState` with `Phase.FAILED` and `state.error`.

The [ErrorCode reference](/external/reference#errorcode) lists every code.

## Correct a selection

Before the first capture is accepted, update the country or document type:

```typescript
capture.update({ country: correctedCountry, documentType: correctedDocumentType });
```

After a capture has been accepted, changing documents requires a new scan. `state.resumable` indicates accepted captures.

## Resume after failure

`start()` resumes a failed or stopped instance. Expired or rejected credentials require a fresh [capture token](/external/api/create-token) and a new SDK instance for the same scan. See [Resume a scan](/external/resume).

## Browser requirements

Capture requires HTTPS or localhost. Content Security Policy must allow `https://cdn.bouncr.io` for scripts and connections, `blob:` workers, and WebAssembly compilation.
